Ira: Heads up — odd tail spikes on shared-rack-usw2-21, NVLink util climbing to ~90% during tenant bursts (2026-04-10 02:14 UTC). :thinking:
Sam: Which tenants and request profile?
Ira: t-halo and t-mako, lots of small concurrent streams (seq <= 48) and high KV read churn. NVLink P2P TX/RX shows steady peaking.
Vera: If it's NVLink peer traffic, migrating racks won't help. Can we try a reversible soft-shape and a runtime fallback to lower-KV variants?
Sanjay: Proposed short flow: (1) dry-run detection for 48h (no enforcement) -> collect hits; (2) soft-shape via egress policer + kvcache aggressive TTL (30s windows) behind FF; (3) if sustained >10m -> ephemeral carveout + prewarm and notify CS/Finance.
Ira: I tested a short policer in staging; NVLink util dropped to ~55% and 95p latency recovered. No client errors in canary.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20260410-4 created (dry-run).
Sam: Action items: Sam — run 48h dry-run prom rule (ETA: now); Sanjay — PR for noise-detector labeling + soft-shape executor (ETA: EOD); Vera — draft CS note and trial carveout terms (ETA: 48h).
Ira: Thanks team — will post dry-run summary in #eng-infra when done. :white_check_mark:
